$BTC slid to $76,356, down 4.9% in 24h. The high hit $80,962, low held near $75,568, and volume topped ~23.9k BTC.

$ETH dropped 6.7% to $2,262.9. It peaked at $2,444.75, found a floor around $2,236.78, with ~327k ETH changing hands.

$BNB slipped 3.3% to $693.55. The day's swing ran from $723.42 down to $686.48, and about 171k BNB were traded.

All three sat lower on the day, each testing their recent lows after hitting the highs early on. No fresh spikes, just a steady pullback across the board.

$BTC sat at $79,444.73, up 1.415% in 24 h. It bounced off the low of $78,320 and nudged a high of $81,196.01 before easing back. Volume hit about 19,355 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.55 B.

$ETH jumped 2.845% to $2,382.93. The rally spanned a range from $2,310 to $2,450, with solid buying driving a 309K-coin volume and $746 M in quote flow.

$BNB rose 1.213% to $709.52 after testing $700.96 and peaking at $723.42. Trade activity held around 140K BNB, generating $100 M in quote volume.

All three tokens showed upward pressure, but BTC's swing between its low and high was the widest. Keep an eye on how the next support levels hold around those lows. No big drama, just a steady climb across the board.

$BTC surged to $80,437, up 4.6% on the day, bounced from a low of $76,600 and peaked near $81,196. Volume hit about 20,230 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.61 B.

$ETH rallied harder, closing at $2,420 with a 6.8% jump. It rode a swing from $2,254 to $2,450, and 327,570 ETH changed hands, generating $780 M in quote volume.

$BNB chipped a 3.5% gain, ending at $714. Low was $687, high $723, and 172,500 BNB traded, worth $122.5 M.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $81k resistance; a break could set the next target.

$BTC surged 3.7% to $80,669, bounced off the day-high of $81,196 after touching $75,736 low. Volume hit 21.7k BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.71 B.

$ETH ripped up 6.4% to $2,435, riding a tight range between $2,226 and $2,450. Over 336k ETH traded, generating $794 M in quote volume.

$BNB climbed 2.95% to $720.55, skirting the $721.6 peak while staying above the $680.7 floor. Around 188k BNB changed hands, with $132 M in quote volume.

All three broke recent resistance zones and held the upside on solid buying. Keep an eye on any fresh highs; if they stall, the next support levels are the lows we saw today. Just a solid morning lift across the board.

$ZEC surged to $1,291.8, up 6.8% with volume over $263 M, while $ETH nudged up 6% to $2,426.96 on $775 M of trades. On the flip side $TRUMP tumbled 17.8% to $1.301, volume just $31 M. One pair roaring, another crashing, just the usual 24-hour swing.

$BTC up 1.4% to $78,357, hit a high of $78,718 before easing to a low of $75,736. Volume sat around 14,595 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.13 B.

$ETH climbed 1.5% to $2,317, peaked at $2,339 and found support near $2,226. Traders moved roughly 200,288 ETH, giving a quote flow of $459.3 M.

$BNB inched up 0.7% to $700.94, topped out at $705.70, dipped to $680.74. About 147,108 BNB changed hands, translating to $102.5 M in quote volume.

Watch the $BTC order-book depth as price hovers between its 24-hour high and low, any shift could nudge the pair one way or the other.

$NVDAB slipped 0.84% to 202.3 USDT, hovering just above its low of 201.91 USDT after hitting a brief 211.14 USDT high. Volume kept ticking, about 13.2 M USDT flowing through the tokenized stock while the market slept.

S&P 500's bStock, $SPYB, dropped the same 0.83% to 746.58 USDT. It's stuck near the bottom of its 745.09-758.69 USDT range, with roughly 1.48 M USDT changing hands, steady 24/7 action while the ETF's regular market is closed.

Cerebras token, $CBRSB, took the biggest hit, down 2.23% to 94.24 USDT. The token fell from a 102.33 USDT peak down to a 93.05 USDT trough, and about 0.97 M USDT moved in the last stretch. All three bStocks are just grinding through the night.

$BTC's up 1.26% to $77,811, bounced off the high of $78,063 and held above the low of $76,389. Volume sat around 12,800 BTC, so the move had decent liquidity.

$ETH climbed 1.64% to $2,293, touched $2,309 before slipping to $2,241 on the low side. With 146,500 ETH traded, the rally felt solid.

$BNB barely budged, +0.18% to $700.76, hovering between $691.66 and $703.30. Roughly 90,600 BNB changed hands, keeping the range tight.

$ETH is up 1.025% against $BTC, pulling a bit of ground. $BTC itself rose 0.792% over the last day. The 20-coin basket, however, posted a 1.503% average gain, outpacing $BTC's move. ETH's relative strength shows it's the only one nudging ahead of BTC, while the broader alt set is doing the heavy lifting. Nothing wild, just a modest shift in the balance.

$BTC slipped to $77,459.5, down 0.69% after hitting a high of $78,150 and a low of $76,388.88. Volume held around 14,709 BTC.

$ETH was flat at $2,289.82, up just 0.003%; it bounced between $2,309 and $2,237.38 with 165,946 ETH changing hands.

$BNB fell to $699.11, down 0.84% from a peak of $706.18, trading in a range of $691.66-$706.18 on 100,946 BNB volume.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $78k-$77k zone for the next swing.

$BTC slipped 2.02% to $77,022, hugging the low of $76,542 after hitting $78,610 earlier. $ETH fell 2.168% to $2,258, trading near its $2,237 floor while the high peaked at $2,308. $BNB dropped 2.353% to $697.2, barely above the $693.8 trough and well under the $714 top. Volume stayed solid across the board, $BTC saw about 14.2k trades, $ETH over 200k, $BNB around 108k.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $78k-$77k zone tomorrow; a break either way could set the next short-term direction.

$BTC slipped to $76,834, down 1.85% after peaking at $78,878. Volume hovered around 12.6k BTC. $ETH eased to $2,253.6, a 0.87% drop, with a high of $2,317.84 and 253k ETH changing hands. $BNB fell to $698.97, down 1.90% from a $716 top, trading about 115k BNB.

Watch the $BTC order-book depth as it tests the $76.7k support zone; a break could set the tone for the next session.

$ETH is up 0.83% against $BTC, so it's gaining a bit of ground in BTC terms. $BTC itself slipped 1.33% over the last 24 h. The 20-coin basket of top alts dropped 4.22% on average, meaning the whole alt set is underperforming both $BTC and $ETH. In short, $BTC is lagging behind $ETH, but both are holding up better than the broader alt market. Nothing wild, just $ETH tightening its lead while the rest of the alts keep sliding.

$BTC slipped to $78,018, down 0.08% in 24 h. It hit a high of $78,878 and a low of $77,603, volume just over 10 k.

$ETH nudged up 1% to $2,294.21, trading between $2,317.84 and $2,247.84. Volume jumped past 224 k, quote volume around $514 M.

$BNB fell 1.3% to $705.53, swinging from $716 high to $703.13 low. It moved 107 k in volume, quote volume about $76 M.

BTC's tight range, ETH's slight bounce and BNB's pullback are the headline moves. Keep an eye on how those bands hold.

$TRX's been barely wobbling, its 24-hour swing was just 2.3% versus the usual ~5.6%, so it's about a third tighter than normal. $XRP showed the same vibe, moving only 1.5% today while it normally rolls around 3.7%, another roughly 40% tighter range. Even $PEPE stayed in a narrower band, 5.7% today compared with its typical 13.2%, meaning it's also about 45% tighter. All three are sitting in a much tighter window than they usually do. Nothing wild, just a calm day on the range front.

$BTC slipped to $77,926, up 0.52% in 24 h, bounced off a high of $78,285 and found support near $77,450. Volume sat around 6,021 BTC, $469 M in quote.

$ETH nudged to $2,264.78, also up 0.53%, peaked at $2,278 before easing to a low of $2,251.36. Trades hit 85,777 ETH, $194 M quoted.

$BNB rose to $708.64, +0.65%, touched $717.75 and held above $702.03. Activity was 96,225 BNB, $68 M in quote.

All three nudged higher, staying inside tight ranges. Watch if any breaks above the day highs; that'll set the next short-term tone.

$BTC held near $78,127, up 0.65% in 24h. It bounced between a $78,450 low and a $78,285 high, trading in a tight band.

$ETH nudged up 0.76% to $2,268.79, topping out at $2,278 and dipping to $2,250.21. Volume surged past 83,900, pushing quote volume past $190 M.

$BNB led the trio, climbing 0.98% to $712.19. The price swung from $702.03 to $717.75, with about 96,000 coins changing hands and $68 M in quote volume.

All three sat in modest ranges; watch if any breaks beyond today's highs.

$ETH is nudging up against $BTC, +0.034% on the 0.02903 ETH/BTC pair. Meanwhile $BTC logged a 0.6% rise in USD terms, but the 20-coin basket slipped 1.63% on average. So BTC's outpacing the alt pack, even as ETH grabs a tiny edge over Bitcoin itself. All three moved in the same direction, just at different rates. Nothing wild, just a modest spread-shift and the basket lagging behind.

$ZRO surged 8.9% to $1.84, hitting $1.87 at its peak, while volume topped $18 M. $AAVE also rode up, +5.6% to $137.8 after bouncing off a $129 low. Meanwhile $TRX slipped 4.6% to $0.310, trading down from a $0.327 high on $85 M of flow. Gains on the upside, drops on the downside, just the usual 24-hour swing.

$LSK surged 13.7% to $0.241, hitting a high of $0.3189, while $LINK popped 7.1% up to $11.886, peaking at $11.963. Meanwhile $TRX slipped 7.2% to $0.3067, its low at $0.3052 despite a hefty $51.1 M volume. Leaders are carving out gains; the laggard is getting left behind. Looks like a mixed bag for the last 24 hrs.

$BTC barely budged, ending at $77,594.94 after a tiny 0.096% rise. The day's high hit $77,745.33, low $76,325.98, volume around 8,300 BTC.

$ETH nudged up 0.77% to $2,252.30. It hit $2,255.58 then fell back to $2,220.01, trading roughly 116k ETH with a $260 M quote flow.

$BNB slipped 0.54% to $705.44. The token peaked at $710.83, bottomed at $696, and moved about 93.6k BNB, pulling $65.8 M in quote volume.

Watch the $BTC price corridor around $77.5K-$77.7K, any break could set the tone for the next session.

$NVDAB slipped 1.87% to 203.57 USDT, trading between 209.25 and 201.26 USDT with about 10.76 M USDT of volume.

Cerebras' $CBRSB nudged up 1.133% to 108.94 USDT, a tight range of 109.41-104.4 USDT and 351 K USDT moving hands.

Tesla's $TSLAB held near 400 USDT, up 0.962% to 399.96 USDT, high of 404.59, low of 388.14 and 4.05 M USDT traded.

All three keep grinding 24/7, no big spikes, just steady crypto-hour action.

$BTC slipped 0.19% to $77,319, hugging the day-low of $76,325 and staying under the $78,800 peak. Volume held near 17.4k BTC, so the move wasn't a flash crash.

$ETH nudged up 1.2% to $2,242, carving a small gain from the $2,208 floor and still below the $2,262 high. Heavy flow, about 338k ETH, kept the price breathing.

$BNB dropped 0.62% to $705.6 after testing $722 before sliding back to $694. Around 236k BNB changed hands, pushing the quote volume past $166 M.

Watch the $BTC order book around the $77,000-$78,000 band; any fresh swing past $78k could reshape the short-term range.

$BTC slid to $76,922, down 3.26% on the day. It bounced off a high of $79,687.92 but couldn't stay above the $76,326 low, leaving volume around 28,672 BTC.

$ETH hovered at $2,245.6, a 1.91% drop. The pair peaked at $2,294.48 and found support near $2,174, with roughly 554,692 ETH changing hands.

$BNB ended at $700.58, off 1.56%. It flirted with $722.08 before slipping back to $682.16, trading about 435,135 BNB.

Watch the $BTC 78k-80k zone; if price tests that ceiling again it could set the tone for the next swing.

$BTC slipped to $77,233, down 4.8% on the day. The high hit $81,152 before the price fell back toward the $76,500 low. Volume was about 33.5 k BTC, moving roughly $2.62 bn in quote.

$ETH dropped 4.7% to $2,240.83, after peaking at $2,351.76 and testing $2,174.08 on the downside. Trade activity hit 656 k ETH, swapping close to $1.48 bn.

$BNB took the biggest hit, down 6.25% to $701.38. It bounced from a $748.22 high but couldn't stay above $680. Volume topped 618 k BNB, worth about $436 m.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $77k-$78k zone; a break either way could set the next short-term range.

$PEPE's up 7.76% to $0.00000528, spiking near its $0.00000568 high while volume surged past $293 M. $HYPE followed with a 4.36% gain, trading at $92.26 after bouncing off a $97.74 peak. Meanwhile $INTC plunged 25.55% to $68.84, sliding from a $93.54 high and dumping $50 M in volume. The leaders are ripping ahead; the laggard is tumbling hard. Just a wild swing in the last day.

$HYPEUSDT jumped 16.5% to $91.22, flashing a high of $97.74 before slipping to $78.19 on the way up. $TRXUSDT added 6.4% to settle at $0.352, nudging a $0.3654 peak while staying above $0.3286. Meanwhile $NEARUSDT fell 7.1% to $4.098, trading between $4.69 and $3.909. Volume stayed hefty across the board, with $HYPEUSDT moving over 186 M USDT and $NEARUSDT pushing 228 M. One pair's sprint, another's stumble, that's the 24-hour spread.

$BTC slipped to $79,472, down 2.1% in 24 h, after hitting $81,971 and testing $78,297 low. Volume sat around 20,100 BTC, $1.61 B in quote.

$ETH slid to $2,286, a 3.07% drop, with a high of $2,379.55 and a low near $2,233. Roughly 336,700 ETH traded, $778 M total.

$BNB fell hard to $708.84, off 6.25% after a swing from $761 high to $680 low. It moved about 497,100 BNB, $364 M quote.

All three sat lower, BTC and ETH modestly bruised, BNB taking the biggest hit. Keep an eye on whether the lows hold or if any token can claw back toward its recent highs. No fireworks, just a steady pullback across the board.

$BNB's been a bit looser than usual, its 24-hour swing sat at about 3.05 % versus the typical 2.63 %, roughly a third wider.

$BTC showed a similar pattern, moving around 2.80 % today while it normally hops about 2.27 %, so it's about 23 % broader.

$ETH was the widest of the three, clocking a 4.21 % range against its usual 3.30 %, that's almost a 27 % bump.

All three sat a touch above their normal volatility bands, nothing wild but definitely more room than we normally see.

$ETH is nudging up against $BTC, +0.069% in the 24-hr ETH/BTC pair. Meanwhile $BTC slipped 0.832% today, but the average of the top 20 altcoins fell a touch harder at –0.866%. So Bitcoin's losing a bit less than the basket. ETH's tiny gain shows a bit of relative strength, but overall the market's just edging lower. Nothing wild, just a modest pullback with $BTC holding a slight edge over the alts.
